# Lepons

> Lepons is a free desktop app (Windows, macOS; MIT) that runs Claude Code and Codex sessions from several PCs — this PC and remote servers or VMs over SSH — in one window, and lets those PCs share codebases live through an MCP server tunnelled over SSH.

- Download: https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/releases/latest
- Guide (Korean): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.md
- Guide (English): https://github.com/joyuno/lepons/blob/main/README.en.md

## Key facts
- Nothing is installed on remote PCs; SSH is enough. tmux keeps sessions alive across disconnects.
- Sharing: drag a folder onto another PC on the sharing map; that PC's agents read it with `search_repo` and `read_file`, file by file, with secrets masked.
- Shows Claude Code and Codex plan usage (5-hour and 7-day limits) as batteries.
